_doc: Per-mission terrain THEME system (2026-09-11 follow-up to the FLUX 128px art bump). User complaint: the default floor checkers two unrelated-looking materials (floor_metal/floor_tech) every other tile - visually noisy. Fix: one coherent floor material per theme, several wear-variants of THAT material picked per-cell so it doesn't look identically repeated, plus a proper city theme (buildings/walls, burn barrels/cars/buses, streets/sidewalks) as a second setting missions can use. wall_tiling.gd's shape classification (STRAIGHT_NS/EW, CORNER, END_CAP, ISOLATED, WINDOW) is already fully wired into battle.gd/CoverObject - this batch is the 'real art' that plan explicitly deferred.
